name: SLG 领地系统
description: Class territory map, contributions and resource yield. Adopts the two pre-existing tables (territories, class_resources) instead of renaming them - SELECT * rows are returned straight through to the frontend. Student points and the shared ledger go through classroom.public, never through this plugin's own SQL.

data._adopted_note: Both carry their legacy names because `SELECT *` rows are returned straight through to the frontend (id, status, current_contribution, cost_to_unlock, x_pos, y_pos). Renaming them is a coordinated migration, tracked as namespace debt by guardrail G10. `students` and `records` are deliberately absent: they belong to classroom and are reached through classroom.public.
data._auth_note: All eight routes now resolve the caller from the kernel request context: 401 for anonymous (未登录或登录已过期), 403 for a role that may not call the route (无权限执行该操作). They are also scoped - the map is readable only by the class's teacher or a student in that class, territory creation and yield only by the class's teacher (admin/superadmin pass), and a contribution only by the student row the caller's own login owns, so the URL's :studentId / :classId are never treated as identity. The pre-migration surface answered every one of these to an anonymous caller.
